name: Estimate an order of magnitude
short_description: Estimate an order of magnitude once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can estimate an order of magnitude in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Estimate an order of magnitude means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Estimate an order of magnitude in a fresh real-life scenario.
